I love that idea! Having local artists perform would definitely add a special touch. Do you have anyone specific in mind?
I was thinking about reaching out to Sarah from the open mic nights. She has a wonderful voice and really engages the audience. Do you think she'd be a good fit?
Absolutely! Sarah would be a fantastic fit. Her energy is perfect for our vibe. Can you reach out to her and see if she’s available? Also, let’s discuss what time we’d want her to perform.

Sure, I can reach out to Sarah right after our chat. As for her performance time, how about we schedule her for around 7 PM? That way, we can have her set the mood as guests are arriving. What do you think?
